name: W47 MPLS Planet Fitness — Return Ramp (Mon–Fri)

monday.label: Push (Chest / Shoulders / Triceps)
monday.warmup: Treadmill incline walk 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + DB front raise 5 lbs × 10 + ramp-up sets of incline press at 25 ea × 8 then 40 ea × 4
monday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side + overhead triceps stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: Was 60 ea (12/12/11 on 10/19). Deep stretch at the bottom, wrists stacked. Stop at 10
Was 60 ea (10/10/9 on 10/19). No spotter: rack the DBs before anything grinds
Was 30 (12/10/10 on 10/19). Slow into the stretch. No lengthened partials this week
Was 50 ea in this slot (10/10/10 on 10/19). Strict, no leg drive
Was 20 ea (10/10/9 on 10/19). Strict, no swing
Was 40 (12/11/11 on 10/19). Elbows pinned, easy grip on the rope
Was 60 (10/10/7 on 10/19). Seated with back support. Get the DB into position with both hands

tuesday.label: Pull (Back / Biceps / Rear Delts)
tuesday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + ramp-up sets of lat pulldown at 70 × 8 then 90 × 5. The 70 is the load that was pain-free on 11/10. If the 90 set bothers the forearm, do the working sets at 70 and log it
tuesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body rear-delt stretch 60s ea side. No forearm stretching this week. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: Was 130 (10/10/9 on 10/27). Chest up, full stretch at the top, no lean-back
Was 135 (12/12/12 on 10/27, the banked lock). Pause at the chest. 100 was pain-free on 11/10
Forearm lift at about 70% of the 70 ea from 10/27. LEFT first, right matches left's reps, no torso heave
Was 60 (15 × 3 on 10/27, the banked lock). Rope to the ears, strict
Was 20 ea (15 × 3 on 10/27, the banked lock). Soft elbows
Forearm lift: was 60 (10 × 3 on 10/27). Only if the forearm is quiet after slot 3. No 40 bar on the rack → 20 lb DBs for the same sets. No hip swing
Forearm lift: was 30 ea. This one loads the forearm most directly; skip it at the first hint of discomfort and log why
Forearm lift: was 75 ea for 25 s. 20 s each side, LEFT hand first. Set it down early if the grip fades

wednesday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)
wednesday.warmup: Easy treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + ramp-up sets: squat bar × 8, 95 × 5; leg press 180 × 8
wednesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + standing quad stretch 45s ea side + hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free

exercises.notes: Was 140 (12/12/12 on 10/21). 25+10+2.5 per side. Cap 8 for soreness. Pain-free depth, exhale on the drive
270 × 12 × 3 on 11/10; the pre-layoff lock was 320. 45+45+45+10 per side. Feet hip-width, do not bottom out
Forearm lift (grip): was 140 (10/8/8 on 10/21). One 25 per side. Cap 8, double-overhand, no straps, slow on the way down
70 went 12/12/12 on 11/10 → 75, reps reset to 10. Full range, pause at the bottom
90 × 10 × 3 on 11/10; was 110 before the layoff. Chin tucked; sit up 20–30 s before standing
Was 260 (15/15/15 on 10/21). Cap 12. Full range, 1 s pause, no bounce
Was 60 (12/12/12 on 10/21). Exhale into the crunch, easy grip
The plate that went 15 × 3 on 10/21, at 12 reps. Smooth, no hyperextension

thursday.label: Upper Hybrid (Shoulders / Chest / Back / Arms / Core)
thursday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + scap circles + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + ramp-up sets of shoulder press at 20 ea × 8 then 35 ea × 4
thursday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

Was 55 ea (12/12/11 on 10/22). Lighter second exposure, 5 under Monday

friday.label: Lower Hybrid (Glutes / Quads / Hams / Calves / Core)
friday.warmup: Easy bike or treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + ramp-up sets on the single-leg press (90 lbs × 6 each leg, left first)
friday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + quad, hamstring and calf stretches 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free
